pubsub_topic.description: The Pub/Sub topic to send notifications to. Format: projects/[project_id]/topics/[topic].
pubsub_topic.rationale: Notifications may contain sensitive findings. Using an insecure or unauthorized topic risks exposing data to unintended subscribers.

streaming_config.rationale: Defines which findings trigger notifications. Weak or missing filters may allow irrelevant data or exclude critical issues.

filter.description: Filter expression for selecting findings. Supports operators (=, >, <, :, etc.) and logical combinations (AND, OR, NOT).
filter.rationale: Proper filtering ensures only relevant high-severity findings are sent. Overly broad or empty filters can reduce the effectiveness of alerting.

organization.description: The organization in which the Notification Config is defined.
organization.rationale: This field defines scope but does not directly affect the security of the notification configuration.

config_id.description: Unique identifier for the notification config within the organization.
config_id.rationale: Ensures uniqueness but does not directly affect security posture.

description.description: Optional description of the notification config (max 1024 characters).
description.rationale: Descriptions are informational only and do not affect security.
